The numbers for "Casino 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2775.headline: New game, all prizes left

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" just reached Texas stores with eight top prizes of $30,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

The numbers for "Patriotic Payout" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2776.headline: New in stores
